steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: According to the guide... this is our first destination today, the ever-blooming flower field!
But isn't this just a small park...?
You and Letta stand in front of a nameless park in an Eastside suburb, staring at each other.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Perhaps the flower field lies in this park...?
Possibly... But given the season, it's unlikely we'll see any flower field. Maybe that's why it's a strange tale.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... Let's go in and have a look!
Are you here to visit? Welcome!
A man in staff uniform emerges and approaches them hospitably.
Hello, we were wondering if, um... is this the ever-blooming flower field?

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: You're exactly right! Here, you'll enter a fairyland where flowers bloom in all seasons! To experience the miraculous scenery, you need only...
He raises a small board which reads: Entry Ticket: 100 DisCoins/Person.
Letta stares at you with an anticipating look and tugs at your shirt. You sigh.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: That'll be 200 DisCoins, thank you!
The staff member takes the money and leads you into the park with a wide grin.
The park is not exactly big. After taking a small path, you see a field of vivid colors distantly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Wow! That's the flower field...
Excited, she wants to get closer, but is immediately stopped by the straight-faced staff member.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Please don't go any closer, Miss. This flower field can only be viewed at a distance. Once the flowers are tainted with human scent, they'll wilt instantly... and this magnificent scenery will be no more!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh, I remember now, the strange tale does mention that. Too bad then...
Letta halts her steps awkwardly. Something feels off to you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Ah, the wind...
A gust of wind rolls up the hem of her dress. She presses on her hat to prevent it from getting blown away by the rising wind.
Suddenly, Letta opens her eyes widely and stares ahead in surprise. You follow her gaze and find that half of the flower field has collapsed in the wind.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Ah! My flower field!
The staff member shouts and runs over in panic.
You follow him and finally see the truth of the flower field. They're merely fake flowers propped up in the soil.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I see, the ever-blooming flowers... are fake...

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Sh-shush!
He refutes defensively as he tries to set the collapsed fake flowers right. But as soon as he fixes a bunch, the other ones get blown down again, so his effort is all wasted.
Don't waste your time. Those at the back have all gone down too.
You point at the fake flowers facing down on the distant slope. Finally, the staff member gives up and slumps down on the ground wearily.
He sighs as he plucks off his hat, and begins to vent at you.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: I'm so sorry. As you can see, the ever-blooming flower field doesn't exist... The flowers are not real.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: This park has poor operations and mediocre landscapes. It's going out of business.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: But I wanted to make a final attempt. I pulled some strings and got these fake flowers that were going to the landfill and created the fake scenery...

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Then I made up a lot of exaggerated rumors and spread them as much as possible, hoping to attract more visitors and sell some tickets.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Once I earn enough money, I can buy some seedlings and grow a real flower field...

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: But for now, the fake flowers remain fake... I'm really sorry. Please forgive me!
His honest confession somehow leaves you speechless.
Letta is still staring blankly at the flower field, as if still processing the disappointment from her ruined fantasy.
Letta, what do you think?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Oh, me? Well, it is what is it! I'm fine!
She snaps out of the daze and gestures to the staff member indifferently.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The park is still beautiful... I hope the next time we visit, we'll see a real flower field!
You say goodbye to the park's staff member. Letta leads you to the next destination enthusiastically, the steel maze of the roaring monster.
This is a rooftop piled with construction materials and pipes. The metal lies silently in the dark and divides the space into several dim diverging paths, indeed making the place seem like a maze.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Legend has it that when the night falls, the monster in the heart of the maze roars furiously to intimidate all intruding enemies...
But I hear no roars...
Just as you say that, the ground beneath your feet suddenly vibrates and the pipes around you begin rumbling.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Listen! The monster's roaring!
Letta feels the pipes carefully to detect the source of the roar and immediately starts going in that direction excitedly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Come, Mr. Chief, let's go find the monster!
steps.female_content: Come, Miss Chief, let's go find the monster!

steps.content: You nod and let Letta lead the way.

Having been fooled by the previous strange tale, you don't have high expectations for the remaining destinations. But the environment here is kind of spooky... Perhaps it'll prove slightly more legit than the fake flowers at the park?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The path ends here... Oh, a door?
Fumbling along the pipes, you reach the end of the maze and find a door on the wall that seems to lead downstairs.
You hear the constant roars through the metal door, from the interior of the building. Letta turns the handle but fails to open it.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Of course, we mustn't leave the adventure unfinished! Follow me closely!
The lantern flickers. Letta holds your hand and leads you through that locked door.
Behind it is a dark, long corridor with only an eerie glimmer glowing at the distant end. She raises the lantern to repel the darkness. The deeper you go, the louder the roars grow.
Through your linked hands, the shackles pass all of Letta's excitement and anxiety to you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I'm so excited... Chief, what do you think we'll see this time?
Before you can answer, a cacophony of clanks interrupts you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Is that the monster...?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It's alright, I'm not scared... If anything happens, I'll get you out of here... Ah!
In the pitch black, you're suddenly met with several pairs of eyes.
Letta screams instinctively. You're equally shocked by the sudden sight. You immediately drag her back and stand before her.
At the peak of your anxiety, the eyes begin talking.
Who are you? How did you get in?
The clanks resume as the eyes gradually hover toward you. Letta's lantern dims with fear, so the light is just enough for you to make out their appearance. To your relief, those are human eyes.
Several workers dressed in heavy gear stand there, dark masks covering their entire faces. Their eyes are the only bare parts on their bodies; they stare at you in confusion.
And they're still carrying different tools as if they've just left their duties hurriedly.
Behind them, a large machine is still running dutifully, the pipes connecting to it rumbling rhythmically. That's it. That's the roar.

steps.speaker: Worker
steps.content: Are you... spies sent by that factory across the street?

steps.speaker: Worker
steps.content: We only work discreetly at night, and still you've managed to sneak into the factory...
Though only their eyes are visible, you can sense the deepening suspicion and hostility in them.

steps.speaker: Worker
steps.content: No way, we won't let you leak what you've seen!
Having said that, they close in on you in an attempt to subdue you.
...Hold on! I'm an Eastside sheriff. I received a complaint from this lady here about nighttime noises from this site that disturbed the neighborhood. I'm here for an inspection.
You straighten your back immediately and imitate the tone of a sheriff on duty, trying to turn the situation around.
Why are you operating large machinery outside working hours? This is against the regulations.
Show me your special permit if you have one. Otherwise, I'll report this to my superior and temporarily close down this site.
Intimidated by your confidence and righteousness, the workers' attitude softens.

steps.speaker: Worker
steps.content: Permit... Of course we have one, but we don't have it with us now. Please give us a chance, we'll make sure we have all the papers ready next time!
...Alright, I'll let you off this time. I'll come back again tomorrow, but you must cease your work for today.

steps.speaker: Worker
steps.content: Sure, no problem...
The workers turn off the machine, pack up their tools, and file out of the exit on the other side. You grab Letta's hand and turn back to the way you came at once.
We must leave before they notice something's wrong!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: G... Got it!
After coming down from the rooftop, Letta calms herself and says gratefully while holding onto you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Mr. Chief, how could you remain so calm in that situation...
steps.female_content: Miss Chief, how could you remain so calm in that situation...

steps.content: Ahem... Years of training taught me that.
You touch your nose and ask.
Letta, seeing that the last two locations were hugely different from the descriptions in the tales, the other ones may be the same... Should we continue?
Letta gazes into the pitch black maze and remembers the narrow escape just now. She nods and smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Yes! We're only halfway through our exploration, don't give up so soon!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Now that we've survived that kind of scary strange tale, whatever may come will be nothing more than a sprinkle of water, to put it in the mother tongue of that little kid!
She opens the DisCity Adventure Journal she's brought with her to look for the next destination.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Amazing, the midnight phantom ball happens to be nearby! Let's go there now!
As soon as you turn into that dark alley she's marked out, you hear eerie music coming out of it. Before the hidden archway at its end, several bizarre figures are lurking.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... Could those be the phantoms?
... I suppose so?

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Yo, are you two newbies? Never seen you before!
A phantom notices you and hovers over, the long hem of his outfit trailing behind.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Your look is a tad too plain to match our theme...
He judges your outfit disapprovingly before turning his gaze onto Letta and nodding appreciatively.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Little Miss here has put in much more effort in her costume! Though you don't appear exactly like a phantom, you look cute and those accessories are on point!

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: The masquerade ball begins soon. Let's have a dance together once you're in there!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Masquerade ball? Isn't this the phantom ball?

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Yes, this is a phantom-themed masquerade ball!
The phantom is briefly caught off guard by Letta's question, and then goes on to answer her.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Don't tell me you took that gimmicky ad seriously?

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: This dance hall is known for its supernatural-themed midnight events. They make ads in strange tale formats as a gimmick.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: It seems that the descriptions are so realistic that many believe they're true stories... Well, guess their marketing strategy worked!
At that moment, understanding dawns on you both: this strange tale too is fake.
Under the phantom's cordial invitation, you still step inside the dance hall.
Having been fooled by several fake attractions by now, you begin to worry that Letta may feel disappointed or frustrated.
To your surprise, the second she steps inside, she becomes entranced by the dancing phantoms on the dance floor. You see none of the expected negative emotions on her face.
Letta, what do you think of the adventures we've just had?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe... They're very fun!
Letta answers unthinkingly, her eyes bright.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Moreover, all the destinations were chosen by me. I decide where we go and what we do! It feels so good!
Even if the result might be different from what you imagined?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sigh, I won't say I wasn't disappointed...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But these are my own choices, so even if I'm faced with setbacks, I'll accept that without regrets.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: After all, what's an adventure if it's without surprises or accidents?
Her optimism finally calms your nerves.
That's good to hear. These strange tale locations have all been a bit too surprising, so I was worried that might ruin your day.
Hearing that from you reassures me.
Letta blushes in embarrassment.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: After all the things I've asked of you, I'm even making you worried. Sorry...
You're my Sinner, of course I care about your feelings.
There's only one destination left. We mustn't leave the adventure unfinished, right?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Exactly! Off we go!
